name: Hand-Drawn Animation: Location Establishing Clip
description: Video preset for a location clip in the Hand-Drawn Animation look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second establishing shot. State the camera move, time of day, and two things moving in the scene. Keep the architecture consistent with the entity.
context_prompt: short establishing clip of the location with one slow camera move and ambient life in the frame, classic hand-drawn 2D animation cel, confident tapered ink line, simple rounded shapes built to move, flat colour with one soft shadow pass, gouache painted background, warm storybook palette, soft ambient light, full animation with squash and stretch, clear anticipation and overshoot, arcs on every move, multiplane parallax in the background
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, anime, gritty texture, extra limbs, blurry, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
